title: Q-CFP-no-idle-preview-workers: preview Workers idle past the limit are removed
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** CF-POSTURE-1 daily probe, rule `no-idle-preview-workers` failed on the live account
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation cfposture --rule no-idle-preview-workers
**Status:** closed

Each idea preview is a Worker that counts against the account's script limit and is never cleaned up. Measured 2026-11-20: eight us-idea-* Workers idle since 2026-11-15.

Remedy: have the spinoff sweep delete a preview Worker once its idea is launched or declined

Measured:
- us-idea-16438b610e
- us-idea-3b145446e4
- us-idea-4bc6af0cea
- us-idea-7f16de273d
- us-idea-9fcb2077cc
- us-idea-b7adf8fd63
- us-idea-df25e6aced
- us-idea-efb6b23d9c

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-24T17:51:56Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 77.3 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
